definitions.gloss: era name; name of an imperial era
definitions.explanation: A name assigned to a period of years in the Japanese calendar system, traditionally changing with each new emperor. Examples include 令和 (Reiwa), 平成 (Heisei), and 昭和 (Shōwa).

examples.japanese: {今|いま}の{年号|ねんごう}は{令和|れいわ}です。
examples.english: The current era name is Reiwa.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{年号|ねんごう}が{発表|はっぴょう}されたとき、{日本中|にほんじゅう}が{注目|ちゅうもく}した。
examples.english: When the new era name was announced, all of Japan paid attention.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{西暦|せいれき}と{年号|ねんごう}の{両方|りょうほう}が{使|つか}われていて、{公的|こうてき}な{書類|しょるい}には{年号|ねんごう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In Japan both the Western calendar and era names are used, and official documents often use the era name.

notes:
A fundamental concept in Japanese culture and daily life. Government documents, official forms, and many business documents use the {年号|ねんごう} system alongside or instead of the Western calendar ({西暦|せいれき}). Learners in Japan will encounter {年号|ねんごう} on everything from insurance forms to driver's licenses.

RECENT ERA NAMES:
- {令和|れいわ} (2019-present)
- {平成|へいせい} (1989-2019)
- {昭和|しょうわ} (1926-1989)
- {大正|たいしょう} (1912-1926)
- {明治|めいじ} (1868-1912)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年号|ねんごう}が{変|か}わる: for the era name to change
- {年号|ねんごう}を{使|つか}う: to use the era name system
- {新|しん}{年号|ねんごう}: new era name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {元号|げんごう}: era name — synonymous; {元号|げんごう} is the more formal/official term, while {年号|ねんごう} is more commonly used in daily conversation
- {西暦|せいれき}: Western calendar year — the Gregorian calendar system, the alternative to {年号|ねんごう}
- {和暦|われき}: Japanese calendar — the calendar system based on {年号|ねんごう}
